disambiguation: Not a single-file format converter; its core job is selecting a note's dependencies and exporting them as a bundle whose links still resolve.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Documentation is a demo vault shipped with every release and browsable in the repository; debug messages are hidden by default.
problem: Sharing a single note loses its images and breaks its wiki-links, while copying the whole folder shares more than intended.
